comment: Second places of clubs that row at more than one site, checked by hand. new club id -> "of" (the club's id in the import), "site" (added to its name), address, water (catalog entry, added when missing) and launchPoint. Applied by club_import.apply_extra_sites on every import and by scripts/fix_unknown_waters.py; a matching water-fixes.json entry with "near" lets the snap move the launch point to the shore.

launchPoint.precision: shore of the Havel near the Gatow site, Kladower Damm 45, 83 m away (water checked by hand)
near the Elbe-Seitenkanal site, Elso-Klöver-Straße (approximate, water checked by hand)
shore of the Lösegraben at the boathouse, Am Schifferwall 6 (checked by the owner)
